# O2V Framework

> O2V Framework, also known as Opportunity-to-Venture Framework, is a front-end opportunity judgment framework for the AI era. It helps convert opportunity signals into verifiable business cases and venture assets.

Official site: https://www.opportunity2venture.com  
Creator and copyright holder: Li Zhi  
Official public release version: O2V Framework 20260510  
Internal version: v1.4  
Languages: English, Chinese, German

## Core Definition

O2V stands for Opportunity-to-Venture. It is designed to help entrepreneurs, innovators, consultants, and early-stage investors evaluate whether an opportunity signal can become a verifiable, executable, manageable, investable, and assetable venture opportunity.

## 9-Step Judgment Chain

Signal → Scenario → Persona → Pain → Product → Validation → Business Case → Asset → Financing Story

## Business Case Validation Chain

Benefits Hypothesis → MVP → Leading Indicators → Financial Metrics → Verification Plan

## Framework Deliverables

Opportunity Signal List, Opportunity Card, O2V Score, Compliance Risk Level, Business Case, Validation Plan, Assetization Path, Financing Story.
